void RTC_DS3231::adjust(const DateTime &dt) {
  uint8_t buffer[8] = {DS3231_TIME,
                       bin2bcd(dt.second()),
                       bin2bcd(dt.minute()),
                       bin2bcd(dt.hour()),
                       bin2bcd(dowToDS3231(dt.dayOfTheWeek())),
                       bin2bcd(dt.day()),
                       bin2bcd(dt.month()),
                       bin2bcd(dt.year() - 2000U)};

scope: Actual Analog Devices DS3231 datasheet and Adafruit RTC implementation fetched in memory, fixed hashes and textual excerpts retained. Original RTL, no copied implementation or physical accuracy certification.
